title: NotificationRequested
description: Published by many producers on the `finpay.notification` topic to request an outbound notification (EMAIL/SMS/PUSH). The notification-service consumes it asynchronously; notification failures must never affect the originating financial flow. Partitioned by notificationId.

eventId.description: Globally unique event identifier. Consumers MUST deduplicate on this field (outbox redelivery / at-least-once semantics).

eventType.description: Fixed event type; matches the schema name and the stream-filterable discriminator.

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

version.description: Major schema version of this event. Additive changes stay at the same major; breaking changes require a new vN/ schema.

partitionKey.description: Kafka partition key; equals the business key notificationId.

notificationId.description: Notification request identifier; used for idempotency and reconciliation.

payloadRef.description: Stable reference under which the notification content/template payload can be resolved by notification-service (e.g. template id + locale or content key).
